title: Ebara 1996 AF circumferential failure strain by region

quantity.name: failure strain
quantity.definition: nominal gauge strain at the maximum stress before failure, gauge-region failures only, ~0.0001 /s

source.authors: Ebara S, Iatridis JC, Setton LA, Foster RJ, Mow VC, Weidenbaum M
source.sample: 60 multiple-layer circumferential AF specimens, 15 per region (anterior outer AO, anterior inner AI, posterolateral outer PO, posterolateral inner PI), from the L3-L4 discs of 15 lumbar spines (autopsy, frozen -20 C), Thompson grade I-II

protocol.summary: L3-L4 hemidisc; AF blocks from anterior and posterolateral regions, each split into inner and outer halves, microtomed to uniform thickness, soaked 15 min in 0.15 M NaCl, then a dumbbell cut with its long axis along the disc circumference (multi-layer, fibres at about +-30 deg to the load axis). Specimen ~10 mm long; gauge region 3.7 x 4.4 x 2.3 mm (L x W x T); thickness increased 17 % with soaking. Spring-loaded self-gripping jaws with polishing paper, test bath 0.15 M NaCl; preconditioning 10 cycles at 0.4 Hz to 0.05 N, then 0.1 N tare held 15 min; elongation at 0.07 mm/min (~0.0001 /s, quasi-static). Strain = change in gauge-mark length / initial gauge length (video dimension analyser); stress = force / undeformed cross-section. Per specimen cubic fit sigma = A eps + B eps^3; tensile modulus E = d sigma/d eps of the fit at 75 % of failure strain; failure stress/strain = maximum stress before failure and its strain, only for the 32 specimens that failed in the gauge region (24 failed at the grips, 4 by delamination outside the gauge).
how_to_simulate: Multi-layer circumferential AF strip (gauge 3.7 x 4.4 x 2.3 mm), lamellae at about +-30 deg to the load axis, region-specific properties (anterior/posterolateral, outer/inner)
Grip the ends, sides free, tare 0.1 N; pull circumferentially at ~0.0001 /s (quasi-static) in 0.15 M NaCl
Report nominal stress (force / undeformed area) vs gauge nominal strain

extraction.check_notes: Bar chart read from the native page scan: frame top/bottom located per column (the printed frame is rotated ~1 deg and slightly keystoned), bar top and SD whisker cap located by pixel runs; value = axis_max x (bottom - y)/(bottom - top). Axis 0-30 % (13.8 px per %). n = 5/12/8/7.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
